Found it. When you open a feed with nothing unread, the app looks for the next folder that still has unread stories, and if there wasn’t one anywhere it kept looping through your folders until it ran out of stack and crashed. It’s fixed in the next Android release (a big release! version 15.0, coming probably tomorrow or later this week), which I’ll push out shortly. Until then, switching the filter to All Stories avoids it.
